name: self-healing-distributed-cache
description: Self-healing distributed cache with consistent hashing, gossip protocol, and zero-downtime rebalancing

scripts.start:node1: cross-env NODE_ID=node-1 NODE_PORT=3001 NODE_GOSSIP_PORT=4001 SEED_PORT=3001 tsx src/node/CacheNode.ts
scripts.start:node2: cross-env NODE_ID=node-2 NODE_PORT=3002 NODE_GOSSIP_PORT=4002 SEED_PORT=3001 tsx src/node/CacheNode.ts
scripts.start:node3: cross-env NODE_ID=node-3 NODE_PORT=3003 NODE_GOSSIP_PORT=4003 SEED_PORT=3001 tsx src/node/CacheNode.ts
scripts.start:cluster: concurrently "npm run start:node1" "npm run start:node2" "npm run start:node3"
